start.title: The Shore
start.text:
The boat lands in strange country.
A distant cry tears the silence.

turn_back_consequence.title: Stay With Him
turn_back_consequence.text:
He does not turn back.
Walk where he walks.

hide_consequence.title: Come Out
hide_consequence.text:
His presence is your shelter.
Walk beside him.

tombs.title: Among the Tombs
tombs.text:
Broken chains scatter the ground.
A man lives among the dead.

mock_consequence.title: Have Compassion
mock_consequence.text:
He is tormented, not despised.
Look with mercy.

villagers.title: The Villagers' Fear
villagers.text:
Villagers warn, "No one can bind him."
They beg you to leave.

flee_consequence.title: Do Not Flee
flee_consequence.text:
Their fear is not your faith.
Stand with him.

argue_consequence.title: Watch and Trust
argue_consequence.text:
This hour is for witnessing.
Be still and see.

confront.title: He Runs to Jesus
confront.text:
The man falls down before him.
"What do you want with me?"

step_consequence.title: Let Him Act
step_consequence.text:
Your hands cannot heal here.
Only his voice can.

command.title: Come Out of Him
command.text:
Jesus speaks, calm and clear.
"Come out of this man."

doubt_consequence.title: See What Follows
doubt_consequence.text:
Open your eyes to his power.
The demons hear him.

cover_consequence.title: Hear His Voice
cover_consequence.text:
His word frees the captive.
Listen.

pigs.title: Into the Herd
pigs.text:
The herd rushes down the cliff.
The man lies still and silent.

mourn_consequence.title: A Soul Is Worth More
mourn_consequence.text:
He is worth more than many herds.
Rejoice.

restored.title: Go and Tell
restored.text:
The man sits clothed, in his right mind.
"Tell what the Lord has done."
